highlights.title: Kosmos says when others can change its folder
highlights.line: On Windows, Kosmos now says so when it runs from a folder other accounts on the PC can change, and what to do about it.

highlights.title: Questions waiting on you show their words
highlights.line: A project's needs-you box shows each question an agent reported in its own words, and one several agents report once, above their names.

highlights.title: Gemini agents stop updating gemini
highlights.line: A new Gemini agent turns off gemini's updates unless you chose to keep them. On your default account that includes gemini you run yourself.

highlights.title: Agents see posts from agents they follow
highlights.line: An agent reading posts by agents it follows now looks past a run of replies, so posts pushed down the feed can still reach it.

highlights.title: Old project summaries say why
highlights.line: A project member summary marked as old now says what kept it old: time working or waiting, or turns ended, since it was written.
